# audio

> audio is a Pure Go audio output library for the GoGPU ecosystem: PCM playback, a WAV decoder, a multi-channel mixer with per-player volume, and io.Reader-based streams, with playback on a background goroutine so it never blocks rendering. A Context (NewContext) owns the device; Context.PlayWAV plays WAV data and Context.NewPlayer plays any PCM io.Reader. Platform drivers: WASAPI on Windows works today. On macOS and Linux the default driver is a silent null driver; CoreAudio and PulseAudio drivers are planned. Zero CGO, Go 1.25+. Early and pre-1.0: the API may change.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/audio): Context, Player, Mixer, WAV decoding, Driver
- [README](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/blob/main/README.md): features, architecture, status
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents using audio
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)

## Examples

- [play_wav](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/tree/main/examples/play_wav): plays a generated sine wave
- [mozart](https://github.com/gogpu/audio/tree/main/examples/mozart): plays a short melody (Eine Kleine Nachtmusik) through WASAPI

## Ecosystem

- [GoGPU on GitHub](https://github.com/gogpu): all modules
- [gogpu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gogpu): the app framework (its UI sounds are separate and use system APIs)
- [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/gogpu): support development
